steps.title: Identify Connection Failure Issue
steps.description: Review the network transmission failure stating that cleartext HTTP traffic to 127.0.0.1 is not permitted by modern Android OS defaults.

steps.title: Analyze Android Network Security Defaults
steps.description: Examine the default security policies introduced in Android 9 (API 28+) which disable cleartext HTTP traffic unless explicitly enabled.

steps.title: Inspect AndroidManifest.xml Configuration
steps.description: Locate the application node in the Android manifest to configure security policy adjustments.

steps.title: Configure Cleartext Support in Manifest
steps.description: Add the android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" attribute into the application block to allow direct HTTP traffic to local addresses.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Permissions
steps.description: Ensure that both standard INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions remain declared to execute HTTP calls.

steps.title: Review Local LLM Endpoint Connectivity
steps.description: Confirm that MainActivity.java addresses http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/chat/completions properly over plain HTTP protocol.

steps.title: Validate Database and Metadata Handling
steps.description: Ensure the SQLite manager updates conversational message transcripts reliably once local LLM server results stream back.

steps.title: Verify UI Status Updates
steps.description: Confirm that connection status indicators properly reflect offline, online, and connecting states in response to the transaction updates.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Namespace and Structure
steps.description: Verify the xmlns:android namespace matches the official schema definition, preserving compiling standard practices.

steps.title: Building Hospital AI Booker
steps.description: Perform standard compilation of the modified APK file with cleartext HTTP operations permitted to make local API connections succeed.
